##### Project general facts

Kempinski Marina Residences is a premium waterfront development set within the prestigious Dubai Marina, designed to deliver refined urban living with a strong connection to its surroundings. The architecture is defined by elegant lines and contemporary forms, complemented by expansive terraces that incorporate greenery and private outdoor spaces. A selection of one-bedroom apartments to spacious five-bedroom duplexes is thoughtfully planned to maximize views of the marina and skyline, while open layouts and floor-to-ceiling glazing create bright, sophisticated interiors with a seamless indoor-outdoor flow.

The project offers a comprehensive range of lifestyle amenities tailored to both wellness and leisure. Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art fitness center, temperature-controlled swimming pool, and dedicated sports facilities including basketball and padel courts. Landscaped areas and lounge spaces provide a relaxed social environment, while direct access to the vibrant marina promenade connects residents to waterfront dining, retail, and entertainment, creating a dynamic yet balanced living experience.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials, reflecting a modern and elegant design approach. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, combining functionality with contemporary aesthetics, while living spaces are designed to maintain comfort and visual harmony. The residences are offered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalize their homes while benefiting from a premium standard of finishing throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Marina is an iconic and prestigious waterfront community situated along the shoreline of Dubai. As one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods, it offers a captivating blend of urban sophistication, leisure, and breathtaking views.

The centerpiece of Dubai Marina is the man-made canal, which stretches over three kilometers and is surrounded by a collection of stunning high-rise buildings and luxurious waterfront residences. This vibrant development is known for its modern architecture and impressive skyline, making it a distinctive landmark in the city.

Living in Dubai Marina offers residents a lifestyle of convenience and luxury. The community is home to a wide range of amenities, including world-class restaurants, upscale shopping malls, and trendy cafes. The iconic Marina Walk provides a delightful promenade for leisurely strolls, with various dining and entertainment options overlooking the tranquil waters.
